COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No. 1923 of 2024
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Amar Shukla, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Narain Dutt, Standing Counsel 
for the State/respondent nos. 1 to 6.
The petitioner claims his retiral dues.
It is the case of the petitioner that he 
was superannuated on 31.05.2024. Now, 
his retiral dues could not be processed 
because the respondents have raised an 
objection that in the year 2017, the 
petitioner’s salary was wrongly fixed in 
accordance with 7th Pay Commission. What 
is argued is that, in fact, the petitioner had 
opted to be governed as per 6th Pay 
Commission because his ACP was due in 
the month of March, 2017 and accordingly, 
his pension was rightly calculated. But 
now, misplaced objection has been raised.
State was required to file counter 
affidavit, but it has not been filed.
Let State file its counter affidavit 
within three weeks. Two weeks thereafter, 
rejoinder affidavit, if any, may be filed.
List on 20.05.2025 for final hearing.
The Court makes it abundantly clear 
that the respondent no.1 shall by then pay 
admitted retiral dues to the petitioner. The 
scope of the petition may be confined to 
the issue which is in dispute.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 19.03.2025
Jitendra

Mr. Rakesh Singh Kunwar, 
Additional CSC, for the State. 
(2) Petitioner retired from service on 
31.5.2024, while serving as officiating 
Nayab Tehsildar. According to him, he is not 
being paid pension, gratuity and other dues. 
Relief sought in the writ petition is as 
follows:
“i. Issue a writ, order or direction in 
the nature of mandamus commanding and 
directing the respondents to forthwith release 
the retiral dues of the petitioner including the 
pension and its arrears alongwith interest @ 
18% in terms of (unrevised pay scale Rs. 
15600-39100 Grade Pay Rs. 5400/-) in revised 
Level-10 pay scale Rs. 56100-177500.”
(3) Learned State Counsel submits 
that counter affidavit could not be filed so 
far. On his request, adjourned to 29.6.2026 
to enable him to file counter affidavit in the 
meantime. 
(4) If counter affidavit is not filed 
before the next date of listing, then 
Secretary, Revenue, Government of 
Uttarakhand shall appear in person before 
this Court along with entire record of the 
case. 
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
